diagram_previews.alt: Seven congruent circles in a hexagonal arrangement around a central circle with centre O, inside a large circle tangent to the six outer ones; the six curved gaps around the central circle are shaded purple, the dashed equilateral triangle O P1 P2 of side 2r joins three centres, and a blue radius of the large circle is labelled 3r.
